sloka: ततस्तु नीलो विजयी महाबलः प्रशस्यमानः स्वकृतेन कर्मणा ।समेत्य रामेण सलक्ष्मणेन च प्रहृष्टरूपस्तु बभूव यूथपः ।। ६.५८.६० ।।
transliteration: tatastu nīlo vijayī mahābalaḥ praśasyamānaḥ svakṛtena karmaṇā ।sametya rāmeṇa salakṣmaṇena ca prahṛṣṭarūpastu babhūva yūthapaḥ ।। 6.58.60 ।।

translations.english: CommanderinChief killed, those Rakshasas reduced to speechlessness went to the abode of their Lord and remained without consciousness.
